findings.issue: Tautological: compares colour_of to colour_of. Colour correctness vs spec is only ordering checks (red<orange<white).

Key floor check re-states the formula (KEY_FLOOR_SHARE*key_base); a wrong floor constant of 0.25 is also asserted literally, fine, but the 25% is a hand-tuned readability value with no render comparison at 20/25/40%.
Perf evidence vsync-bound (~9.5 ms p95 everywhere): deltas 'within noise' cannot show a cost smaller than the vsync headroom. Weak, though per-frame work is tiny (one star loop, one light).
